mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ث?
mcq.explanation: The letter ث is called thaa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَتَكَلَّمُ بِفَمِي mean?
mcq.explanation: أَتَكَلَّمُ بِفَمِي (atakallamu bi-famii) means: I speak with my mouth.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I have a gift."
mcq.explanation: عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ (ʿindii hadiyya) means: I have a gift.

mcq.q: Why should a knife be kept out of the reach of small children?
mcq.explanation: Sharp items can hurt small children.

mcq.q: What does qawiyy mean?
mcq.explanation: qawiyy means strong.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "beautiful"?
mcq.explanation: جَمِيلٌ (jamiil) means beautiful.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable سُ?
mcq.explanation: سُ is read su.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مَسَاءُ الْخَيْرِ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مَسَاءُ الْخَيْرِ is read masaa'u l-khayr and means good evening.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "I am well"?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ (anaa bi-khayr) means I am well.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَيْنَ الْكِتَابُ؟ mean?
options: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The lamp is above the table.
mcq.explanation: أَيْنَ الْكِتَابُ؟ (ayna l-kitaab?) means: Where is the book?

mcq.q: How wide should the space between two words be?
options: About the width of one letter
mcq.explanation: A small even space keeps words apart without breaking the sentence.

mcq.q: What is the sound dh in udhun like in English?
mcq.explanation: The letter dh is like the th in 'this'.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The table is small."
mcq.explanation: الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ (at-taawilatu Sagiira) means: The table is small.

mcq.q: In which direction is Arabic written?
mcq.explanation: Arabic is written from right to left.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مَطَرٌ (matar) mean?
mcq.explanation: مَطَرٌ (matar) means rain.

mcq.q: What does ilmis anfaka tell you to do?
mcq.explanation: ilmis means touch and anfaka means your nose.

mcq.q: Which sentence says 'I hear with my ear'?
mcq.explanation: asmaʿu means I hear and udhun means ear.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word حَمَّامٌ (hammaam) mean?
mcq.explanation: حَمَّامٌ (hammaam) means bathroom.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word غَدًا read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: غَدًا is read ghadan and means tomorrow.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word حَقِيبَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: حَقِيبَةٌ is read haqiiba and means bag.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I like food."
mcq.explanation: أُحِبُّ الطَّعَامَ (uhibbu T-taʿaam) means: I like food.

mcq.q: Which day has the letter jiim in its name?
mcq.explanation: الجمعة contains jiim (ج).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ (as-salaamu ʿalaykum) mean?
mcq.explanation: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ (as-salaamu ʿalaykum) means peace be upon you.

mcq.q: What is a prediction?
options: A sensible guess about what will happen next
mcq.explanation: We use clues to predict what may happen next.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable بُ?
mcq.explanation: بُ is read bu.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "grandfather"?
mcq.explanation: جَدٌّ (jadd) means grandfather.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word قَلْبٌ (qalb) mean?
mcq.explanation: قَلْبٌ (qalb) means heart.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word خُبْزٌ (khubz) mean?
mcq.explanation: خُبْزٌ (khubz) means bread.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "write"?
mcq.explanation: اُكْتُبْ (uktub) means write.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The water is clean."
mcq.explanation: الْمَاءُ نَظِيفٌ (al-maa'u nadhiif) means: The water is clean.

mcq.q: What does at-taawilatu Sagiira mean?
mcq.explanation: taawila is table and Sagiira means small.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word سَمَكٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: سَمَكٌ is read samak and means fish.

mcq.q: Which body part is used for the action 'aktubu' (I write)?
mcq.explanation: We write with the hand (yad).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مِفْتَاحٌ (miftaah) mean?
mcq.explanation: مِفْتَاحٌ (miftaah) means key.

mcq.q: Which strategy uses a picture or the sentence to guess a word?
mcq.explanation: Cues are clues such as pictures and the words around the new word.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَغْسِلُ وَجْهِي mean?
mcq.explanation: أَغْسِلُ وَجْهِي (aghsilu wajhii) means: I wash my face.

mcq.q: What does the shadda over the last letter of umm tell the reader?
mcq.explanation: A shadda doubles the sound.

mcq.q: Which letter has one dot above it?
mcq.explanation: nuun has one dot above. Baa has one dot below, taa has two dots above and yaa has two dots below.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable تَ?
mcq.explanation: تَ is read ta.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word لَذِيذٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: لَذِيذٌ is read ladhiidh and means delicious.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "milk"?
mcq.explanation: حَلِيبٌ (haliib) means milk.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word فِي (fii) mean?
mcq.explanation: فِي (fii) means in.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence جَدَّتِي تُحِبُّنِي mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: جَدَّتِي تُحِبُّنِي (jaddatii tuhibbunii) means: My grandmother loves me.

mcq.q: What does the word wa mean in khubzan wa bayDan?
mcq.explanation: wa means 'and', so the phrase is 'bread and eggs'.

mcq.q: What is phonological awareness?
mcq.explanation: Phonological awareness is being aware of the separate sounds in words.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'The window is clean'?
mcq.explanation: naafidha is window and nadhiifa is the feminine form of clean.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ mean?
options: Above the table there is a balloon.
On the table there is a cake.
The friends are at the party.
mcq.explanation: عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ (ʿalaa t-taawilati kaʿka) means: On the table there is a cake.

mcq.q: Which of these Arabic words (in English letters) means 'clouds'?
mcq.explanation: ghaym means clouds.

mcq.q: In which direction is Arabic read?
mcq.explanation: Arabic is read from right to left.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence لِي يَدَانِ mean?
mcq.explanation: لِي يَدَانِ (lii yadaani) means: I have two hands.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "lamp"?
mcq.explanation: مِصْبَاحٌ (misbaah) means lamp.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "chair"?
mcq.explanation: كُرْسِيٌّ (kursii) means chair.

mcq.q: What does the mark shadda tell you in the word umm?
options: The letter mim is said twice
mcq.explanation: A shadda doubles the sound of a letter, so we say um-m.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مِصْبَاحٌ (misbaah) mean?
mcq.explanation: مِصْبَاحٌ (misbaah) means lamp.

mcq.q: Where should you write the Arabic name of a drawing?
options: Under the drawing, from right to left
In the margin from left to right
mcq.explanation: Labels are written neatly from right to left.

mcq.q: Which pair of words are two family members from the father's side and the mother's side?
mcq.explanation: ʿamm is the father's brother and khaal is the mother's brother.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "My mother cooks."
mcq.explanation: أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ (ummii tatbukhu) means: My mother cooks.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ mean?
options: My grandfather is old (big in age).
mcq.explanation: جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ (jaddii kabiir) means: My grandfather is old (big in age).

mcq.q: Which describing word matches the feminine noun taawila (table)?
mcq.explanation: A feminine noun takes the describing word ending in -a.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable بُو?
mcq.explanation: بُو is read buu.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "good morning (the reply)"?
mcq.explanation: صَبَاحُ النُّورِ (sabaahu n-nuur) means good morning (the reply).

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word دَجَاجٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: دَجَاجٌ is read dajaaj and means chicken.

mcq.q: What is word spacing?
mcq.explanation: Word spacing is the neat gap between one word and the next.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ل make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ل makes the sound l as in lamp.

mcq.q: How is the syllable بِي read?
mcq.explanation: The letter yaa after a kasra makes the vowel long, so بِي is bii.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word قَلَمٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: قَلَمٌ is read qalam and means pen.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "heart"?
mcq.explanation: قَلْبٌ (qalb) means heart.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "sunny"?
mcq.explanation: مُشْمِسٌ (mushmis) means sunny.

mcq.q: Which is a fault in handwriting?
mcq.explanation: Wide gaps inside a word make it look like several words.

mcq.q: In a passage about the home, which of these is a theme word?
mcq.explanation: A theme word belongs to the topic. A chair is found in the home.

mcq.q: What does legible mean?
mcq.explanation: Legible writing can be read easily by other people.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "sky"?
mcq.explanation: سَمَاءٌ (samaa') means sky.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word سُكَّرٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: سُكَّرٌ is read sukkar and means sugar.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "My grandfather is old (big in age)."
mcq.explanation: جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ (jaddii kabiir) means: My grandfather is old (big in age).

mcq.q: Which sentence gives your own name?
mcq.explanation: ismii means 'my name is', so ismii Ahmad means 'My name is Ahmad'.

mcq.q: The cat is under the bed. Which position word is used?
mcq.explanation: taHta means under.

mcq.q: Which day name comes from the Arabic word for 'one'?
mcq.explanation: al-ahad, Sunday, is the first day.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word الْيَوْمَ (al-yawm) mean?
mcq.explanation: الْيَوْمَ (al-yawm) means today.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable تُ?
mcq.explanation: تُ is read tu.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا بَيْتِي mean?
options: The book is on the table.
The lamp is above the table.
The cat is under the bed.
mcq.explanation: هَذَا بَيْتِي (haadhaa baytii) means: This is my house.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "rice"?
mcq.explanation: أَرُزٌّ (aruzz) means rice.

mcq.q: How many forms can an Arabic letter have at most?
options: Four: alone, start, middle and end
mcq.explanation: A joining letter can look different alone, at the start, in the middle and at the end of a word.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word جَوٌّ (jaww) mean?
mcq.explanation: جَوٌّ (jaww) means weather.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْعَصِيرُ بَارِدٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْعَصِيرُ بَارِدٌ (al-ʿasiiru baarid) means: The juice is cold.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I go to school on Monday."
mcq.explanation: أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ (adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn) means: I go to school on Monday.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ف?
mcq.explanation: The letter ف is called faa.

mcq.q: Which is a good way to take care of the environment?
options: Plant trees and keep the surroundings clean
Cut trees without planting new ones
mcq.explanation: Planting trees and keeping the area clean protect the environment.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable سَ?
mcq.explanation: سَ is read sa.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word افْتَحِ الْبَابَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: افْتَحِ الْبَابَ is read iftahi l-baab and means open the door.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence وَالْمَطَرُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ mean?
options: The sun is in the sky.
And the rain is from the sky.
mcq.explanation: وَالْمَطَرُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ (wal-maTaru mina s-samaa'i) means: And the rain is from the sky.

mcq.q: What can you do when you meet an unknown word in a text?
options: Use the sentence around it to guess its meaning
mcq.explanation: Clues around a word help to infer its meaning.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'The wind is strong'?
mcq.explanation: riih is wind and qawiyya is the feminine form of strong.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ (kayfa haaluka?) mean?
mcq.explanation: كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ (kayfa haaluka?) means How are you? (to a boy).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ (al-maa'u mufiid) means: Water is useful (good for you).

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "big"?
mcq.explanation: كَبِيرٌ (kabiir) means big.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I eat rice."
mcq.explanation: آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ (aakulu l-aruzza) means: I eat rice.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word نَعَمْ (naʿam) mean?
mcq.explanation: نَعَمْ (naʿam) means yes.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "fruit"?
mcq.explanation: فَاكِهَةٌ (faakiha) means fruit.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable مِ?
mcq.explanation: مِ is read mi.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ mean?
options: In the room there is a bed.
In the kitchen there is a table.
mcq.explanation: فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ (fii l-matbakhi taawila) means: In the kitchen there is a table.
